# Crawlers

> crawlers // A curated AI tools directory index organized by use case, not by brand.

## Purpose
Crawlers aggregates and indexes active AI tools, platforms, and conversational agents. It groups them logically into 10 high-level sections (such as Text & Writing, Developer & Tech Tools, Data, Models & Security) to help users find exact solutions based on their task requirements.

## Site Structure
- Homepage: https://crawlers.dpdns.org/ — Main index and search interface.
- Categories: https://crawlers.dpdns.org/category/[slug] — Detailed list of indexed tools for a specific usecase (e.g. copywriting, code-assistant, models).
- Tools: https://crawlers.dpdns.org/tool/[id] — Reviews, stats, pricing models, and direct connection references for individual AI platforms.
- Tags: https://crawlers.dpdns.org/tag/[tag-name] — Cross-category tag search matching specific technology stacks or fields (e.g. llm, web3, voice).

## Compliance & Policy
Crawlers crawls public indexes respecting robots.txt directives, paraphrasing descriptions to maintain originality. It contains link-out references directly to tool sources.
